# Subspaces Angle

![Subspaces Angle function icon](../../../../assets/function-icons/functions/math/linear-algebra/08-subspaces_angle.svg)

[Mathematics functions](../../mathematics/index.md) · [All functions](../../index.md)

Returns the largest principal angle in radians between real column spaces, using orthonormal numerical-rank bases. Vectors are one-column spaces. This NI-compatible profile is real-only; null/rank-difference policy is a GS numerical decision, not a certified NI behavior. Inputs calculate in DBL/CDB with explicit numeric promotion; 64-bit integers above 2^53 may round. No broadcasting, no private Matrix reinterpretation. error is I32 and never an automatic dialog. Optional unwired defaults: none.

<details>
<summary>Résumé français de l’aide Studio</summary>

**Subspaces Angle**

Calcule le plus grand angle principal entre les espaces de colonnes réels, en radians. Les bases sont orthonormalisées et leur rang numérique est pris en compte. Valeurs facultatives non câblées : none.

</details>
